id-20260822-news-2.title: Pindar Financing to SMEs Surpasses Rp35.12 Trillion, Growing 23.25 Percent in First Semester 2026

segments.src: Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) mencatat tren positif pada sektor pinjaman daring atau Pindar (dahulu dikenal sebagai fintech peer-to-peer lending) yang disalurkan kepada pelaku Usaha Mikro, Kecil, dan Menengah (UMKM).
segments.tr: The Financial Services Authority (OJK) recorded a positive trend in the online lending or Pindar sector (formerly known as fintech peer-to-peer lending) distributed to Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (SMEs).

segments.src: Hingga Juni 2026, total pembiayaan yang mengalir ke segmen ini tercatat menembus angka Rp35,12 triliun, atau tumbuh 23,25 persen secara tahunan (year on year).
segments.tr: By June 2026, the total financing flowing to this segment reached Rp35.12 trillion, or grew 23.25 percent year on year.

segments.src: Pertumbuhan ini menegaskan peran platform Pindar berizin sebagai salah satu sumber permodalan alternatif yang semakin diandalkan pelaku usaha kecil, terutama bagi mereka yang selama ini kesulitan mengakses pembiayaan dari perbankan konvensional karena keterbatasan agunan atau rekam jejak kredit.
segments.tr: This growth confirms the role of licensed Pindar platforms as one of the increasingly relied-upon alternative sources of capital for small business operators, especially for those who have had difficulty accessing financing from conventional banks due to limited collateral or credit history.

segments.src: ## Kontribusi Sepertiga dari Total Fintech Lending Nasional
segments.tr: ## One-Third Contribution of Total National Fintech Lending

segments.src: Berdasarkan data OJK, penyaluran pembiayaan ke UMKM lewat Pindar tersebut menyumbang sekitar sepertiga dari total outstanding pembiayaan fintech lending nasional yang mencapai Rp105,14 triliun pada periode yang sama.
segments.tr: Based on OJK data, the distribution of financing to SMEs through Pindar contributed approximately one-third of the total outstanding national fintech lending financing which reached Rp105.14 trillion in the same period.

segments.src: Proporsi ini menunjukkan bahwa segmen usaha kecil dan menengah masih menjadi salah satu fokus utama penyaluran dana melalui skema pinjaman daring, sejalan dengan misi awal industri ini untuk memperluas inklusi keuangan di luar jangkauan perbankan tradisional.
segments.tr: This proportion shows that the small and medium business segment remains one of the main focus areas for fund distribution through the online lending scheme, in line with the industry's initial mission to expand financial inclusion beyond the reach of traditional banking.

segments.src: Sisanya dari total pembiayaan nasional disalurkan ke berbagai segmen lain, termasuk pembiayaan produktif non-UMKM maupun konsumtif, yang bersama-sama membentuk ekosistem pembiayaan digital yang terus berkembang di Indonesia.
segments.tr: The remainder of total national financing is distributed to various other segments, including non-SME productive financing as well as consumption financing, which together form a growing digital financing ecosystem in Indonesia.

segments.src: ## Faktor Pendorong Pertumbuhan
segments.tr: ## Growth Driving Factors

segments.src: Beberapa faktor disebut turut mendorong akselerasi penyaluran Pindar ke UMKM, di antaranya:
segments.tr: Several factors are said to be driving the acceleration of Pindar distribution to SMEs, including:

segments.src: - **Adopsi digital yang meningkat** — semakin banyak pelaku usaha kecil yang terbiasa mengajukan pembiayaan secara daring, didukung proses pengajuan yang relatif cepat dan sederhana dibandingkan jalur perbankan konvensional.
segments.tr: - **Increasing digital adoption** — more and more small business operators are becoming accustomed to applying for financing online, supported by a process that is relatively quick and simple compared to the conventional banking channel.

segments.src: - **Perluasan kerja sama ekosistem** — sejumlah penyelenggara Pindar menjalin kemitraan dengan platform e-commerce, penyedia layanan pembayaran, hingga komunitas usaha untuk menjangkau calon peminjam UMKM secara lebih luas.
segments.tr: - **Expansion of ecosystem cooperation** — a number of Pindar operators have established partnerships with e-commerce platforms, payment service providers, and business communities to reach potential SME borrowers more widely.

segments.src: - **Penguatan pengawasan OJK** — regulasi yang semakin ketat terhadap penyelenggara berizin turut membangun kepercayaan pelaku usaha untuk memanfaatkan layanan ini sebagai sumber modal kerja maupun ekspansi usaha.
segments.tr: - **Strengthening of OJK supervision** — increasingly strict regulations for licensed operators help build business operators' confidence in utilizing this service as a source of working capital and business expansion.

segments.src: ## Pentingnya Memilih Platform Berizin OJK
segments.tr: ## The Importance of Choosing OJK-Licensed Platforms

segments.src: Di tengah tren positif ini, OJK secara berkala mengingatkan masyarakat dan pelaku UMKM agar hanya menggunakan layanan pinjaman daring yang terdaftar dan berizin resmi.
segments.tr: Amid this positive trend, OJK periodically reminds the public and SME operators to only use officially registered and licensed online lending services.

segments.src: Status legalitas suatu platform dapat dicek langsung melalui kanal resmi OJK, baik melalui situs web maupun layanan kontak OJK 157.
segments.tr: The legal status of a platform can be checked directly through OJK's official channels, either through the website or OJK contact service 157.

segments.src: Pelaku usaha juga disarankan untuk memahami secara menyeluruh simulasi bunga, tenor, dan kewajiban pembayaran sebelum mengambil pembiayaan, agar pinjaman yang diperoleh benar-benar mendukung produktivitas usaha dan tidak menimbulkan beban keuangan yang memberatkan di kemudian hari.
segments.tr: Business operators are also advised to thoroughly understand interest simulation, tenor, and payment obligations before taking financing, so that the loan obtained truly supports business productivity and does not create a heavy financial burden in the future.

segments.src: ## Prospek ke Depan
segments.tr: ## Future Prospects

segments.src: Dengan tren pertumbuhan dua digit yang konsisten, industri Pindar diproyeksikan akan terus memperluas jangkauannya ke segmen UMKM, khususnya di wilayah-wilayah yang belum sepenuhnya terlayani oleh perbankan formal.
segments.tr: With consistent double-digit growth trends, the Pindar industry is projected to continue expanding its reach to the SME segment, especially in areas not yet fully served by formal banking.

segments.src: Sinergi antara regulator, penyelenggara Pindar, dan ekosistem pendukung UMKM dinilai menjadi kunci agar pertumbuhan pembiayaan ini tetap berjalan sehat dan berkelanjutan, sekaligus memberi manfaat nyata bagi penguatan ekonomi kerakyatan di Indonesia.
segments.tr: The synergy between regulators, Pindar operators, and the UMKM support ecosystem is considered the key to ensuring that this financing growth remains healthy and sustainable, while providing real benefits for strengthening the people's economy in Indonesia.

id-20260822-news-3.title: July 2026 Inflation Falls to 2.88 Percent, Lowest Since Early Year: Widening Room for Bank Indonesia?

segments.src: ## Inflasi Melandai, Sinyal Positif untuk Stabilitas Harga
segments.tr: ## Inflation Easing, Positive Signal for Price Stability

segments.src: Badan Pusat Statistik (BPS) melaporkan laju inflasi tahunan Indonesia pada Juli 2026 turun menjadi **2,88 persen**, melandai dari **3,34 persen** pada bulan sebelumnya.
segments.tr: The Central Statistics Agency (BPS) reported Indonesia's annual inflation rate in July 2026 fell to **2.88 percent**, declining from **3.34 percent** in the previous month.

segments.src: Angka ini menjadi yang terendah sejak awal tahun 2026 dan langsung menarik perhatian pelaku pasar, ekonom, hingga masyarakat umum yang berharap tekanan biaya hidup mulai mereda.
segments.tr: This figure is the lowest since early 2026 and immediately captured the attention of market participants, economists, and the general public hoping that the pressure on cost of living begins to ease.

segments.src: Penurunan ini juga memicu diskusi baru soal kemungkinan Bank Indonesia (BI) memiliki ruang tambahan untuk melonggarkan kebijakan suku bunga acuan, terutama di tengah nilai tukar rupiah yang belakangan menunjukkan tren penguatan terhadap dolar Amerika Serikat.
segments.tr: This decline also sparked new discussions about the possibility that Bank Indonesia (BI) has additional room to ease its benchmark interest rate policy, especially amid the rupiah exchange rate recently showing a strengthening trend against the US dollar.

segments.src: ## Apa yang Mendorong Penurunan Inflasi?
segments.tr: ## What Drives the Decline in Inflation?

segments.src: Menurut data resmi yang dirilis BPS, sejumlah faktor turut berkontribusi terhadap moderasi inflasi bulan Juli, di antaranya:
segments.tr: According to official data released by BPS, several factors contributed to the moderation of July inflation, including:

segments.src: - **Harga pangan yang lebih stabil**, khususnya kelompok bahan makanan pokok seperti beras, minyak goreng, dan bumbu-bumbuan yang tidak mengalami lonjakan signifikan dibandingkan periode sebelumnya.
segments.tr: - **More stable food prices**, particularly staple food items such as rice, cooking oil, and spices that did not experience significant surges compared to the previous period.

segments.src: - **Normalisasi harga energi**, seiring penyesuaian harga bahan bakar dan tarif listrik yang relatif terkendali.
segments.tr: - **Normalization of energy prices**, along with adjustments in fuel prices and electricity tariffs that remained relatively controlled.

segments.src: - **Basis perbandingan tahun lalu (base effect)** yang membuat kenaikan harga tahun ini tampak lebih moderat secara persentase tahunan.
segments.tr: - **Year-on-year comparison basis (base effect)** that made this year's price increases appear more moderate on an annual percentage basis.

segments.src: - **Permintaan domestik yang tumbuh terukur**, tanpa tekanan berlebih pada sisi konsumsi masyarakat.
segments.tr: - **Measured domestic demand growth**, without excessive pressure on household consumption.

segments.src: Deflasi bulanan pada beberapa komoditas volatile food turut membantu menahan laju inflasi inti maupun inflasi umum tetap berada dalam kisaran target pemerintah dan BI.
segments.tr: Monthly deflation in some volatile food commodities also helped keep core inflation and overall inflation within the range targeted by the government and BI.

segments.src: ## Rupiah Menguat, Momentum Ganda bagi Perekonomian
segments.tr: ## Rupiah Strengthening, Double Momentum for the Economy

segments.src: Penurunan inflasi terjadi bersamaan dengan tren penguatan nilai tukar rupiah dalam beberapa pekan terakhir.
segments.tr: The decline in inflation occurred alongside the strengthening trend of the rupiah exchange rate in recent weeks.

segments.src: Kombinasi ini dipandang sejumlah pengamat ekonomi sebagai sinyal positif ganda: harga-harga domestik lebih terkendali, sementara tekanan dari sisi impor dan pembayaran utang luar negeri berbasis dolar berpotensi berkurang.
segments.tr: Several economic observers viewed this combination as a double positive signal: domestic prices more controlled, while pressure from imports and dollar-denominated foreign debt payments could potentially decrease.

segments.src: Meski demikian, penguatan mata uang juga dipengaruhi oleh dinamika global, termasuk arah kebijakan bank sentral negara maju serta pergerakan arus modal asing di pasar negara berkembang, sehingga faktor eksternal tetap perlu dicermati.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, the currency's strengthening is also influenced by global dynamics, including the policy direction of central banks in developed countries and movements of foreign capital flows in emerging markets, so external factors still need to be monitored.

segments.src: ## Ruang bagi Bank Indonesia: Peluang atau Masih Wait and See?
segments.tr: ## Room for Bank Indonesia: Opportunity or Still Wait and See?

segments.src: Dengan inflasi yang berada nyaman di bawah titik tengah target, muncul spekulasi bahwa Bank Indonesia memiliki ruang lebih lebar untuk mempertimbangkan pelonggaran suku bunga acuan pada rapat dewan gubernur mendatang.
segments.tr: With inflation comfortably below the target midpoint, speculation emerged that Bank Indonesia has wider room to consider easing its benchmark interest rate at the next board of governors meeting.

segments.src: Beberapa argumen yang mendasari pandangan ini antara lain:
segments.tr: Several arguments underlying this view include:

segments.src: 1. Inflasi terkendali mengurangi risiko tekanan harga jangka pendek.
segments.tr: 1. Controlled inflation reduces the risk of short-term price pressure.

segments.src: 2. Rupiah yang stabil hingga menguat mengurangi kekhawatiran terhadap dampak pelonggaran moneter pada arus modal keluar.
segments.tr: 2. Stable to strengthening rupiah reduces concerns about the impact of monetary easing on capital outflows.

segments.src: 3. Ruang gerak kebijakan yang lebih fleksibel dapat mendukung pertumbuhan kredit dan aktivitas ekonomi domestik.
segments.tr: 3. More flexible policy room can support credit growth and domestic economic activity.

segments.src: Namun, sejumlah analis juga mengingatkan bahwa keputusan BI biasanya bersifat hati-hati dan mempertimbangkan banyak variabel sekaligus, termasuk stabilitas sistem keuangan, arah kebijakan suku bunga global, serta proyeksi inflasi ke depan yang belum tentu linier dengan tren satu atau dua bulan terakhir.
segments.tr: However, several analysts also reminded that BI's decisions are typically cautious and consider many variables simultaneously, including financial system stability, the direction of global interest rate policy, and forward-looking inflation projections that may not necessarily be linear with the trend of the last one or two months.

segments.src: ## Dampak bagi Masyarakat dan Dunia Usaha
segments.tr: ## Impact on Society and Business

segments.src: Bagi masyarakat, inflasi yang terkendali umumnya berarti daya beli lebih terjaga, terutama untuk kebutuhan pokok sehari-hari.
segments.tr: For society, controlled inflation generally means purchasing power is better maintained, especially for daily basic needs.

segments.src: Sementara itu, bagi pelaku usaha, ekspektasi terhadap arah suku bunga menjadi salah satu pertimbangan penting dalam perencanaan biaya modal, investasi, maupun ekspansi bisnis ke depan.
segments.tr: Meanwhile, for businesses, expectations about the direction of interest rates become one of the important considerations in planning capital costs, investments, and future business expansion.

segments.src: Sejumlah sektor yang sensitif terhadap suku bunga, seperti properti dan otomotif, kerap disebut sebagai pihak yang berpotensi diuntungkan apabila tren pelonggaran kebijakan moneter benar-benar terealisasi dalam beberapa waktu mendatang.
segments.tr: Several interest-rate-sensitive sectors, such as real estate and automotive, are often mentioned as parties that could potentially benefit if the trend of monetary policy easing is truly realized in the coming period.

segments.src: ## Catatan Penting
segments.tr: ## Important Note

segments.src: Data dan proyeksi di atas merangkum informasi publik yang dipublikasikan otoritas statistik serta pandangan umum pengamat ekonomi, dan tidak dimaksudkan sebagai rekomendasi keuangan atau ajakan mengambil keputusan investasi tertentu.
segments.tr: The data and projections above summarize public information published by statistical authorities and general views of economic observers, and are not intended as financial recommendations or an invitation to make specific investment decisions.

segments.src: Kebijakan Bank Indonesia ke depan tetap bergantung pada evaluasi menyeluruh terhadap data ekonomi terbaru serta dinamika global yang terus berkembang.
segments.tr: Future Bank Indonesia policy still depends on a comprehensive evaluation of the latest economic data and evolving global dynamics.

segments.src: Pembaca disarankan mengikuti pengumuman resmi BPS dan Bank Indonesia untuk informasi paling mutakhir.
segments.tr: Readers are advised to follow official announcements from BPS and Bank Indonesia for the most current information.

id-20260822-news-1.title: Indonesia-China's First Comprehensive Strategic Dialogue: Wang Yi Visits Jakarta, Discusses High-Speed Rail to Artificial Intelligence

segments.src: Hubungan Indonesia dan China memasuki babak baru setelah kedua negara menggelar forum **Dialog Strategis Komprehensif** untuk pertama kalinya.
segments.tr: Indonesia-China relations enter a new chapter after both countries held the **Comprehensive Strategic Dialogue** forum for the first time.

segments.src: Pertemuan bersejarah ini berlangsung di Jakarta pada 21 Agustus 2026, mempertemukan Menteri Luar Negeri China Wang Yi dengan Menteri Luar Negeri Indonesia Sugiono.
segments.tr: This historic meeting took place in Jakarta on August 21, 2026, bringing together China's Foreign Minister Wang Yi with Indonesia's Foreign Minister Sugiono.

segments.src: ## Forum Dialog Tingkat Tinggi yang Baru
segments.tr: ## A New High-Level Dialogue Forum

segments.src: Dialog Strategis Komprehensif merupakan mekanisme baru yang disepakati kedua negara untuk membahas isu-isu kerja sama secara lebih terstruktur dan menyeluruh, mencakup bidang politik, ekonomi, hingga teknologi.
segments.tr: The Comprehensive Strategic Dialogue is a new mechanism agreed upon by both countries to discuss cooperation issues in a more structured and comprehensive manner, covering political, economic, and technological fields.

segments.src: Digelarnya forum ini di Jakarta menandakan komitmen China dan Indonesia untuk memperkuat hubungan bilateral yang telah terjalin selama beberapa dekade, sekaligus menyesuaikan arah kerja sama dengan dinamika ekonomi global yang terus berubah.
segments.tr: Holding this forum in Jakarta signifies China and Indonesia's commitment to strengthening bilateral relations that have been established for several decades, while also aligning the direction of cooperation with the constantly changing dynamics of the global economy.

segments.src: Pertemuan antara Wang Yi dan Sugiono ini disebut-sebut sebagai tonggak penting yang akan menjadi acuan bagi pertemuan-pertemuan strategis berikutnya antara kedua negara.
segments.tr: The meeting between Wang Yi and Sugiono is regarded as an important milestone that will serve as a reference for future strategic meetings between the two countries.

segments.src: ## Sektor Energi dan Mineral Jadi Sorotan
segments.tr: ## Energy and Mineral Sectors in Focus

segments.src: Salah satu agenda utama dalam dialog tersebut adalah perluasan kerja sama di sektor energi dan mineral.
segments.tr: One of the main agendas in the dialogue is expanding cooperation in the energy and mineral sectors.

segments.src: Indonesia, sebagai salah satu pemilik cadangan mineral strategis terbesar di dunia seperti nikel, dinilai memiliki posisi tawar yang kuat dalam menjalin kemitraan dengan China di sektor ini.
segments.tr: Indonesia, as one of the world's largest holders of strategic mineral reserves such as nickel, is considered to have strong bargaining power in establishing partnerships with China in this sector.

segments.src: Kedua pihak dilaporkan membahas peluang investasi lanjutan, termasuk potensi hilirisasi industri mineral serta kerja sama di bidang transisi energi bersih.
segments.tr: Both parties reportedly discussed further investment opportunities, including the potential for mineral industry downstream processing and cooperation in clean energy transition.

segments.src: Kerja sama semacam ini diharapkan dapat mendorong pertumbuhan industri dalam negeri sekaligus memperkuat rantai pasok mineral strategis yang menjadi kebutuhan global, terutama untuk mendukung industri kendaraan listrik dan teknologi energi terbarukan.
segments.tr: Such cooperation is expected to promote domestic industrial growth while strengthening the supply chain for strategic minerals that are globally needed, especially to support the electric vehicle industry and renewable energy technology.

segments.src: ## Kereta Cepat Jakarta-Bandung Tetap Jadi Simbol Kemitraan
segments.tr: ## Jakarta-Bandung High-Speed Rail Remains a Symbol of Partnership

segments.src: Proyek Kereta Cepat Jakarta-Bandung (KCJB), yang selama ini menjadi simbol nyata kerja sama infrastruktur RI-China, kembali dibahas dalam pertemuan tersebut.
segments.tr: The Jakarta-Bandung High-Speed Rail (KCJB) project, which has been a concrete symbol of RI-China infrastructure cooperation, was discussed again in the meeting.

segments.src: Kedua menteri luar negeri menekankan pentingnya keberlanjutan proyek ini sebagai bagian dari upaya mempercepat konektivitas dan mobilitas masyarakat di Pulau Jawa.
segments.tr: Both foreign ministers emphasized the importance of sustaining this project as part of efforts to accelerate connectivity and mobility of the people in Java Island.

segments.src: Selain aspek operasional, evaluasi dan penguatan kerja sama teknis diyakini akan terus dilakukan agar manfaat ekonomi dari proyek transportasi ini dapat dirasakan lebih optimal oleh masyarakat luas, termasuk potensi perluasan jalur di masa mendatang.
segments.tr: Beyond operational aspects, evaluation and strengthening of technical cooperation are believed to continue so that the economic benefits from this transportation project can be felt more optimally by the wider public, including the potential for route expansion in the future.

segments.src: ## Kecerdasan Buatan: Arah Baru Kerja Sama Teknologi
segments.tr: ## Artificial Intelligence: A New Direction for Technology Cooperation

segments.src: Yang menarik perhatian dari pertemuan ini adalah masuknya kecerdasan buatan (AI) sebagai salah satu bidang kerja sama baru antara Indonesia dan China.
segments.tr: What stands out from this meeting is the inclusion of artificial intelligence (AI) as one of the new areas of cooperation between Indonesia and China.

segments.src: Kedua negara disebut sepakat untuk menjajaki kolaborasi di bidang pengembangan teknologi digital dan AI, sejalan dengan tren global yang menempatkan kecerdasan buatan sebagai motor penggerak transformasi ekonomi.
segments.tr: The two countries reportedly agreed to explore collaboration in the field of digital technology and AI development, in line with the global trend that places artificial intelligence as the driving force of economic transformation.

segments.src: Langkah ini dinilai relevan mengingat Indonesia tengah berupaya mempercepat transformasi digital nasional, sementara China dikenal sebagai salah satu negara dengan perkembangan industri AI yang pesat.
segments.tr: This step is considered relevant given that Indonesia is working to accelerate national digital transformation, while China is known as one of the countries with rapid AI industry development.

segments.src: Kerja sama di bidang ini berpotensi mencakup transfer pengetahuan, pengembangan talenta digital, hingga penerapan teknologi AI di berbagai sektor strategis.
segments.tr: Cooperation in this field has the potential to include knowledge transfer, digital talent development, and the application of AI technology in various strategic sectors.

segments.src: ## Makna Strategis bagi Hubungan Bilateral
segments.tr: ## Strategic Significance for Bilateral Relations

segments.src: Terselenggaranya Dialog Strategis Komprehensif perdana ini mencerminkan upaya kedua negara untuk memperluas cakupan kemitraan, tidak hanya pada sektor-sektor tradisional seperti perdagangan dan infrastruktur, tetapi juga pada bidang-bidang baru yang berorientasi masa depan seperti teknologi digital dan energi bersih.
segments.tr: The holding of this first Comprehensive Strategic Dialogue reflects the efforts of both countries to expand the scope of partnership, not only in traditional sectors such as trade and infrastructure, but also in new areas oriented towards the future such as digital technology and clean energy.

segments.src: Bagi Indonesia, penguatan dialog strategis dengan China membuka peluang lebih besar untuk menarik investasi, memperkuat kapasitas industri dalam negeri, serta memperluas akses terhadap teknologi mutakhir.
segments.tr: For Indonesia, strengthening strategic dialogue with China opens greater opportunities to attract investment, strengthen domestic industrial capacity, and expand access to cutting-edge technology.

segments.src: Ke depan, hasil dari pertemuan ini akan menjadi salah satu indikator penting yang menentukan arah kerja sama kedua negara dalam beberapa tahun mendatang.
segments.tr: Going forward, the results from this meeting will become one of the important indicators that will determine the direction of cooperation between the two countries in the years to come.

id-20260822-intro-agriculture-4.title: [Agronomy #4] Expensive Fertilizer Can Be Wasteful: The Secret of Nutrients, pH, and Soil "Buffer Capacity"

segments.src: > Tanaman butuh 17 unsur hara, tapi yang paling sering kurang hanya tiga (N, P, K) — dan berapa banyak pupuk yang benar-benar terserap ditentukan oleh pH tanah serta kemampuan tanah menahan perubahan pH.
segments.tr: > Plants need 17 nutrient elements, but the ones that most frequently fall short are just three (N, P, K) — and how much fertilizer is actually absorbed is determined by soil its pH and the soil's ability to resist pH changes.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Bayangkan tanaman sebagai pelanggan warteg.
segments.tr: Imagine a plant as a customer at a local diner.

segments.src: Ia tidak makan "tanah", ia makan **ion** yang larut dalam air di sekitar akar.
segments.tr: It doesn't eat "soil," it eats **ions** dissolved in the water around its roots.

segments.src: Menu lengkapnya ada 17 unsur, dan tanaman tidak bisa hidup normal kalau salah satunya absen.
segments.tr: Its complete menu has 17 elements, and a plant cannot live normally if even one of them is absent.

segments.src: Itulah definisi **unsur hara esensial**.
segments.tr: That is the definition of **essential nutrients**.

segments.src: Tiga di antaranya gratis dari udara dan air: karbon (C), hidrogen (H), oksigen (O).
segments.tr: Three of them are free from the air and water: carbon (C), hydrogen (H), and oxygen (O).

segments.src: Sisanya harus disediakan tanah:
segments.tr: The rest must be provided by the soil:

segments.src: - **Hara makro primer:** nitrogen (N), fosfor (P), kalium (K) — dibutuhkan paling banyak, paling sering habis. Inilah "tiga serangkai" yang jadi isi pupuk NPK.
segments.tr: - **Primary macronutrients:** nitrogen (N), phosphorus (P), potassium (K) — needed the most, run out the most often. These are the "big three" that make up NPK fertilizers.

segments.src: - **Hara makro sekunder:** kalsium (Ca), magnesium (Mg), belerang (S).
segments.tr: - **Secondary macronutrients:** calcium (Ca), magnesium (Mg), sulfur (S).

segments.src: - **Hara mikro:** besi (Fe), mangan (Mn), seng (Zn), tembaga (Cu), boron (B), molibdenum (Mo), klor (Cl), nikel (Ni) — dibutuhkan dalam jumlah sangat kecil, tapi kalau kurang tetap saja tanaman sakit.
segments.tr: - **Micronutrients:** iron (Fe), manganese (Mn), zinc (Zn), copper (Cu), boron (B), molybdenum (Mo), chlorine (Cl), nickel (Ni) — needed in very small amounts, but if lacking, the plant still gets sick.

segments.src: Kasarnya, apa peran tiga besar itu?
segments.tr: Roughly speaking, what are the roles of the big three?

segments.src: - **N** = mesin pertumbuhan daun dan batang. Bahan penyusun klorofil dan protein. Kurang N → daun pucat/menguning, mulai dari **daun tua di bawah** (karena N mudah dipindahkan tanaman ke daun muda).
segments.tr: - **N** = the engine for leaf and stem growth. The building block of chlorophyll and proteins. Lack of N → pale/yellowing leaves, starting from the **lower old leaves** (because N is easily moved by the plant to young leaves).

segments.src: - **P** = urusan energi dan akar. Penting saat bibit membentuk perakaran dan saat tanaman membentuk bunga/biji.
segments.tr: - **P** = energy and roots. Important when seedlings form root systems and when plants form flowers/seeds.

segments.src: - **K** = pengatur. Mengatur buka-tutup mulut daun (stomata), ketahanan terhadap kekeringan dan penyakit, serta kualitas buah (manis, keras, tahan simpan).
segments.tr: - **K** = the regulator. Regulates the opening and closing of leaf stomata, resistance to drought and disease, as well as fruit quality (sweet, firm, good shelf life).

segments.src: Sekarang bagian yang sering dilewatkan orang: **Hukum Minimum (Liebig)**.
segments.tr: Now, the part people often skip: **Liebig's Law of the Minimum**.

segments.src: Hasil panen dibatasi oleh unsur yang paling kurang, bukan oleh unsur yang paling banyak.
segments.tr: Crop yield is limited by the scarcest nutrient, not by the most abundant one.

segments.src: Ibarat ember dari papan-papan kayu dengan tinggi berbeda — air hanya terisi setinggi papan terpendek.
segments.tr: Like a barrel made of wooden planks of different heights — water only fills up to the height of the shortest plank.

segments.src: Menambah urea (N) berkarung-karung tidak ada gunanya kalau yang jadi papan terpendek ternyata boron atau pH tanah.
segments.tr: Adding sacks of urea (N) is useless if the shortest plank turns out to be boron or soil pH.

segments.src: ### Kenapa pH tanah begitu menentukan
segments.tr: ### Why Soil pH is So Decisive

segments.src: **pH** adalah ukuran tingkat kemasaman, skala 0–14; 7 = netral, di bawahnya masam, di atasnya basa/alkalis.
segments.tr: **pH** is a measure of acidity, on a scale of 0–14; 7 = neutral, below it is acidic, above it is basic/alkaline.

segments.src: Mayoritas tanaman budidaya paling nyaman di **pH 6,0–7,0**.
segments.tr: The majority of cultivated crops are most comfortable at **pH 6.0–7.0**.

segments.src: Yang penting: pH tidak "memberi makan" tanaman, tapi ia **mengatur pintu ketersediaan hara**.
segments.tr: Important: pH doesn't "feed" the plant, but it **regulates the gate of nutrient availability**.

segments.src: - Kalau pH turun di bawah ~5,5 (tanah masam — kondisi umum di banyak tanah Indonesia yang basah dan tercuci hujan), aluminium (Al) dan besi larut berlebihan. Al yang larut **meracuni ujung akar** sehingga akar pendek dan tumpul, dan Al/Fe ini **mengikat fosfor** menjadi senyawa yang tidak bisa diserap. Jadi Anda menebar SP-36, tapi P-nya "disandera" tanah.
segments.tr: - If pH drops below ~5.5 (acidic soil — a common condition in many wet, rain-leached Indonesian soils), aluminum (Al) and iron dissolve excessively. Dissolved Al **poisons the root tips** making roots short and blunt, and this Al/Fe **binds phosphorus** into compounds that cannot be absorbed. So you spread SP-36, but the P is "held hostage" by the soil.

segments.src: - Kalau pH terlalu tinggi (di atas ~7,5), giliran hara mikro seperti Zn, Fe, dan Mn yang mengendap dan sulit diserap.
segments.tr: - If the pH is too high (above ~7.5), micronutrients like Zn, Fe, and Mn precipitate and become difficult to absorb.

segments.src: Jadi menaikkan pH tanah masam sering kali memberi lompatan hasil yang lebih besar daripada menambah dosis pupuk.
segments.tr: So raising the pH of acidic soil often gives a bigger yield jump than increasing fertilizer doses.

segments.src: Caranya: **pengapuran (liming)** dengan kapur pertanian — kaptan/kalsit (CaCO3) atau **dolomit** (CaMg(CO3)2, sekaligus menyumbang magnesium).
segments.tr: How to do it: **liming** with agricultural lime — calcitic limestone (CaCO3) or **dolomite** (CaMg(CO3)2, which also supplies magnesium).

segments.src: ### Dan kenapa dosis kapurnya beda-beda: daya sangga
segments.tr: ### And Why Lime Doses Vary: Buffer Capacity

segments.src: Di sinilah masuk **daya sangga (buffer capacity)**: kemampuan tanah menahan perubahan pH.
segments.tr: This is where **buffer capacity** comes in: the soil's ability to resist pH changes.

segments.src: Tanah bukan cuma air.
segments.tr: Soil is not just water.

segments.src: Permukaan partikel **liat** dan **bahan organik** bermuatan negatif, sehingga bisa menahan ion-ion bermuatan positif (Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺, K⁺, NH4⁺, dan juga Al³⁺, H⁺).
segments.tr: The surfaces of **clay** and **organic matter** particles are negatively charged, allowing them to hold positively charged ions (Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺, K⁺, NH4⁺, as well as Al³⁺, H⁺).

segments.src: Kapasitas menahan itu disebut **KTK (Kapasitas Tukar Kation)**.
segments.tr: This holding capacity is called **CEC (Cation Exchange Capacity)**.

segments.src: Cadangan H⁺ dan Al³⁺ yang "menempel" ini akan terus melepas keasaman baru setiap kali keasaman di larutan tanah dinetralkan.
segments.tr: The reserves of H⁺ and Al³⁺ that are "attached" will continuously release new acidity every time the acidity in the soil solution is neutralized.

segments.src: Akibat praktisnya:
segments.tr: The practical consequence:

segments.src: - **Tanah berpasir, bahan organik rendah → KTK rendah, daya sangga lemah.** Sedikit kapur sudah menaikkan pH, tapi hara juga gampang tercuci hujan. Solusi: pupuk sedikit-sedikit tapi sering (split application).
segments.tr: - **Sandy soil, low organic matter → low CEC, weak buffer capacity.** A little lime raises the pH, but nutrients also easily leach away with rain. Solution: fertilize in small amounts frequently (split application).

segments.src: - **Tanah liat berat atau gambut → KTK tinggi, daya sangga kuat.** Butuh kapur jauh lebih banyak untuk menggeser pH yang sama; menaikkan pH gambut secara drastis biasanya tidak ekonomis dan tidak dianjurkan.
segments.tr: - **Heavy clay or peat soil → high CEC, strong buffer capacity.** Takes much more lime to shift the same pH; raising peat pH drastically is usually uneconomical and not recommended.

segments.src: Karena itu rekomendasi kapur yang benar tidak ditentukan dari angka pH saja, melainkan dari **uji tanah** (di Indonesia umumnya berbasis kandungan Al-dd, aluminium dapat ditukar).
segments.tr: Therefore, correct lime recommendations are not determined by pH numbers alone, but by **soil testing** (in Indonesia, generally based on exchangeable Al).

segments.src: Menebak-nebak = buang uang, dan kelebihan kapur justru memicu defisiensi hara mikro.
segments.tr: Guessing = wasting money, and excess lime actually triggers micronutrient deficiencies.

segments.src: ### Membaca angka di karung pupuk
segments.tr: ### Reading the Numbers on a Fertilizer Sack

segments.src: Angka pada pupuk selalu ditulis **N - P2O5 - K2O** (bukan N-P-K murni; ini konvensi lama yang masih dipakai dunia).
segments.tr: Numbers on fertilizers are always written as **N - P2O5 - K2O** (not pure N-P-K; this is an old convention still used globally).

segments.src: - KCl = ~60% K2O
segments.tr: - KCl = ~60% K2O

segments.src: - NPK Phonska = 15-15-15
segments.tr: - NPK Phonska = 15-15-15

segments.src: Menghitung kebutuhan pupuk itu pembagian sederhana:
segments.tr: Calculating fertilizer needs is simple division:

segments.src: Jumlah pupuk = kebutuhan hara (kg) / kadar hara pupuk (desimal)
segments.tr: Jumlah pupuk = kebutuhan hara (kg) / kadar hara pupuk (desimal)

segments.src: Contoh: butuh 92 kg N/ha, pakai urea (46% N)
segments.tr: Contoh: butuh 92 kg N/ha, pakai urea (46% N)

segments.src: 92 / 0,46 = 200 kg urea per hektar
segments.tr: 92 / 0,46 = 200 kg urea per hektar

segments.src: Terakhir, prinsip pengelolaan hara yang dipakai di seluruh dunia — dikenal sebagai **4R** (right source, rate, time, place), dan di Indonesia sering disebut **pemupukan berimbang / 5 Tepat**: tepat jenis, tepat dosis, tepat waktu, tepat cara, tepat sasaran.
segments.tr: Finally, the nutrient management principle used worldwide — known as **4R** (right source, rate, time, place), and in Indonesia often called **balanced fertilization / 5 Rights**: right type, right dose, right time, right method, right target.

segments.src: Pupuk yang benar, dosis yang benar, waktu yang benar, dan **cara benar** — misalnya urea yang ditebar di permukaan tanah panas dan kering bisa menguap sebagai gas amonia dan hilang cukup besar, sehingga sebaiknya dibenamkan atau ditebar sebelum pengairan/hujan ringan.
segments.tr: The right fertilizer, the right dose, the right time, and the **right method** — for example, urea spread on hot, dry soil surfaces can evaporate as ammonia gas and be lost in large amounts, so it is better to incorporate it into the soil or apply it before irrigation or light rain.

segments.src: ## Dalam Keseharian
segments.tr: ## In Daily Life

segments.src: Bu Sri di Lampung menanam cabai rawit di kebun belakang rumah.
segments.tr: Mrs. Sri in Lampung grows bird's eye chili in her backyard garden.

segments.src: Tahun lalu panennya bagus.
segments.tr: Last year the harvest was good.

segments.src: Tahun ini daun-daun bawah menguning, batang kurus, buahnya kecil dan sedikit.
segments.tr: This year the lower leaves are yellowing, stems are thin, fruits are small and few.

segments.src: **Reaksi pertama (yang paling sering terjadi):** beli urea lagi.
segments.tr: **First reaction (most common):** buy more urea.

segments.src: Dengan harga eceran tertinggi pupuk bersubsidi sekitar Rp 2.250/kg untuk urea dan Rp 2.300/kg untuk NPK (angka HET ditetapkan pemerintah dan bisa berubah), sementara pupuk non-subsidi bisa dua sampai tiga kali lipatnya, tambahan pupuk terasa "murah" dibanding rugi gagal panen.
segments.tr: With the highest retail price for subsidized fertilizer around Rp 2,250/kg for urea and Rp 2,300/kg for NPK (government-set HET figures which can change), while non-subsidized fertilizers can be two to three times that, additional fertilizer feels "cheap" compared to crop failure losses.

segments.src: Daun sempat menghijau dua minggu, lalu balik lagi menguning dan sebagian tanaman malah rebah.
segments.tr: The leaves turned green for two weeks, then went back to yellowing and some plants even fell over.

segments.src: **Apa yang sebenarnya terjadi.** Bu Sri ikut program uji tanah dari penyuluh.
segments.tr: **What actually happened.** Mrs. Sri joined a soil testing program from the extension officer.

segments.src: Hasilnya: pH 4,8, Al-dd tinggi, P tersedia rendah meski tiga tahun terakhir rutin diberi SP-36.
segments.tr: The results: pH 4.8, high exchangeable Al, low available P despite routinely giving SP-36 over the past three years.

segments.src: Artinya:
segments.tr: Meaning:

segments.src: 1. Akar cabai kerdil bukan karena kurang pupuk, tapi karena **keracunan aluminium** di tanah masam.
segments.tr: 1. Stunted chili roots are not due to lack of fertilizer, but due to **aluminum toxicity** in acidic soil.

segments.src: 2. Fosfor yang selama ini ditebar **terikat oleh Al dan Fe** — pupuknya masuk, haranya tidak bisa diambil.
segments.tr: 2. The phosphorus spread all this time is **bound by Al and Fe** — fertilizer goes in, but nutrients cannot be taken up.

segments.src: 3. Karena akarnya pendek, N yang ditambahkan pun tidak terserap maksimal dan sebagian **tercuci** terbawa hujan ke lapisan bawah — hilang, sekaligus mencemari air.
segments.tr: 3. Because the roots are short, the added N is not fully absorbed and partly **leaches** away with rain to lower layers — lost, while polluting the water.

segments.src: **Yang dilakukan musim berikutnya:**
segments.tr: **What to do the following season:**

segments.src: - Menebar **dolomit** sesuai dosis hasil uji tanah, disebar merata dan diaduk ke lapisan olah, lalu didiamkan sekitar 2–4 minggu sebelum tanam. Kapur bereaksi lambat — ini bukan obat instan, dan menebarnya bersamaan dengan pupuk N justru merugikan karena mempercepat penguapan amonia.
segments.tr: - Spread **dolomite** according to soil test recommendations, spread evenly and mixed into the plow layer, then let it sit for about 2–4 weeks before planting. Lime reacts slowly — this is not an instant cure, and spreading it together with N fertilizer is actually counterproductive because it accelerates ammonia volatilization.

segments.src: - Menambahkan **pupuk kandang matang/kompos**. Bahan organik menaikkan KTK, memperbaiki daya sangga, menahan air di tanah berpasir, dan menyumbang hara mikro.
segments.tr: - Add **mature manure/compost**. Organic matter increases CEC, improves buffer capacity, retains water in sandy soils, and contributes micronutrients.

segments.src: - Mengubah cara: urea tidak ditebar sekaligus, tapi **dibagi 2–3 kali** dan dibenamkan dekat perakaran, bukan disiram sembarangan.
segments.tr: - Change the method: urea is not spread all at once, but **divided 2–3 times** and incorporated near the root zone, rather than watering haphazardly.

segments.src: Hasilnya: total pupuk yang dibeli **turun**, panennya naik.
segments.tr: The result: total fertilizer purchased **decreased**, harvest increased.

segments.src: Bukan karena Bu Sri menambah input, tapi karena ia memperbaiki papan ember yang paling pendek.
segments.tr: Not because Mrs. Sri added inputs, but because she fixed the shortest barrel plank.

segments.src: Pelajaran yang sama berlaku untuk polybag cabai di teras rumah kota: kalau media tanamnya sudah masam dan padat, menambah pupuk cair seminggu sekali tidak akan menyelamatkan apa pun.
segments.tr: The same lesson applies to chili polybags on a city house terrace: if the growing medium is already acidic and compact, adding liquid fertilizer once a week will not save anything.

segments.src: ## 3 Baris Ringkasan
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Tanaman butuh 17 unsur hara esensial; N-P-K paling cepat habis, dan hasil panen dibatasi oleh unsur yang **paling kurang** (Hukum Minimum), bukan yang paling banyak.
segments.tr: 1. Plants need 17 essential nutrient elements; N-P-K runs out the fastest, and crop yield is limited by the **scarcest** element (Law of the Minimum), not the most abundant one.

segments.src: 2. **pH tanah** mengatur pintu ketersediaan hara — di bawah 5,5 aluminium meracuni akar dan mengikat fosfor, di atas 7,5 hara mikro mengendap; zona nyaman kebanyakan tanaman adalah pH 6–7.
segments.tr: **Soil pH** regulates the gate of nutrient availability — below 5.5 aluminum poisons roots and binds phosphorus, above 7.5 micronutrients precipitate; the comfort zone for most plants is pH 6–7.

segments.src: 3. **Daya sangga** (dari liat + bahan organik, tercermin di KTK) menentukan berapa banyak kapur yang diperlukan dan seberapa mudah hara tercuci — karena itu dosis harus berdasar **uji tanah**, bukan tebakan.
segments.tr: 3. **Buffer capacity** (from clay + organic matter, reflected in CEC) determines how much lime is needed and how easily nutrients leach — therefore doses must be based on **soil testing**, not guesswork.

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **Unsur hara esensial** — 17 unsur yang mutlak diperlukan tanaman untuk menyelesaikan siklus hidupnya; tidak ada satu pun yang bisa digantikan unsur lain.
segments.tr: - **Essential nutrients** — 17 elements absolutely required by plants to complete their life cycle; not a single one can be replaced by another element.

segments.src: - **Hukum Minimum (Liebig)** — hasil panen ditentukan oleh faktor/hara yang paling terbatas, seperti air dalam ember yang hanya setinggi papan terpendek.
segments.tr: - **Liebig's Law of the Minimum** — crop yield is determined by the most limiting factor/nutrient, like water in a barrel that is only as high as the shortest plank.

segments.src: - **pH tanah** — ukuran kemasaman tanah (skala 0–14) yang mengendalikan kelarutan dan ketersediaan hara serta tingkat keracunan aluminium.
segments.tr: - **Soil pH** — a measure of soil acidity (scale 0–14) that controls nutrient solubility and availability as well as aluminum toxicity levels.

segments.src: - **Daya sangga (buffer capacity)** — kemampuan tanah menahan perubahan pH, berasal dari cadangan keasaman yang terjerap pada liat dan bahan organik.
segments.tr: - **Buffer capacity** — the ability of soil to resist pH changes, originating from acidity reserves adsorbed on clay and organic matter.

segments.src: - **KTK (Kapasitas Tukar Kation)** — kapasitas tanah menahan dan menukar ion bermuatan positif seperti Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺, K⁺; makin tinggi KTK, makin subur potensinya dan makin kuat daya sangganya.
segments.tr: - **CEC (Cation Exchange Capacity)** — the capacity of soil to hold and exchange positively charged ions like Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺, K⁺; the higher the CEC, the greater its potential fertility and buffer capacity.

segments.src: - **Pengapuran (liming)** — pemberian kaptan atau dolomit untuk menaikkan pH tanah masam, menetralkan aluminium, dan membebaskan fosfor yang terikat.
segments.tr: - **Liming** — applying agricultural limestone or dolomite to raise acidic soil pH, neutralize aluminum, and liberate bound phosphorus.

segments.src: *Jawaban: **1 → B.** Pada pH rendah, Al dan Fe larut dan mengikat fosfat menjadi senyawa yang sangat sukar larut, sehingga P "ada tapi tidak tersedia".
segments.tr: *Answer: **1 → B.** At low pH, Al and Fe dissolve and bind phosphate into very poorly soluble compounds, making P "present but unavailable".

segments.src: Menaikkan pH lebih efektif daripada menambah dosis P.
segments.tr: Raising pH is more effective than increasing P doses.

segments.src: **2 → X (Salah).** Justru sebaliknya: pasir dengan bahan organik rendah punya KTK dan daya sangga **rendah** — pH mudah bergeser dengan sedikit kapur, tapi haranya gampang tercuci hujan.
segments.tr: **2 → F (False).** Quite the opposite: sand with low organic matter has **low** CEC and buffer capacity — pH easily shifts with a little lime, but nutrients easily leach with rain.

segments.src: Yang butuh kapur banyak adalah tanah liat berat dan gambut.
segments.tr: What needs a lot of lime is heavy clay and peat soil.

segments.src: **3 → C.** `69 / 0,46 = 150 kg urea per hektar`.
segments.tr: **3 → C.** `69 / 0.46 = 150 kg urea per hectare`.

segments.src: Ingat, angka pada karung adalah persentase kadar hara, bukan berat hara murni.*
segments.tr: Remember, the numbers on the sack are the percentage of nutrient content, not the pure nutrient weight.*
